summary: SiteProfileHistory class handles record keeping and tracking of changes or actions within the site profile.
purpose: Track and present the history of changes in site profiles within the system.
fields: ID: int - Identifier for the history record.
ScreenSection: string - Section of the screen where action took place.
UserAction: string - Description of the user action.
Fields: string - Fields that were affected.
AgencyName: string - Name of the agency.
LastName: string - User's last name associated with the action.
FirstName: string - User's first name associated with the action.
MiddleName: string - User's middle name if available.
ByUserID: int - User ID of the person who performed the action.
ByOriginalUserID: int - Original user ID if different from the current user.
ByUserSysAdmin: bool - Indicates if system admin performed the action.
business_rules: Formatting and presentation of user and agency details based on system settings.
system_behavior: Tracks changes in site profiles and provides details for presentation based on session settings.
